LUNAR MISSION – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
LUNAR MISSION is an interactive educational web game designed to help students understand the challenges of human survival on the Moon. Players take on the role of a lunar research base commander and make decisions to manage essential resources, including oxygen, water, energy, and food, while completing different missions.
Our project addresses the challenge of making complex space science concepts more accessible and engaging for young learners. Through mission-based scenarios and resource management activities, players can explore the difficulties of living and working in the lunar environment while developing critical thinking and decision-making skills.
LUNAR MISSION is important because future lunar exploration will require people to understand the challenges of sustaining human life beyond Earth. By combining science education with interactive gameplay, our project inspires students to explore space science and become more interested in the future of space exploration.

Project Details – LUNAR MISSION: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

1. Project Overview

LUNAR MISSION is an interactive educational web game designed to simulate the challenges of managing a human research base on the Moon. Players take on the role of a lunar base commander and complete different missions by making decisions about essential resources, including oxygen, water, energy, and food.

2. How Does It Work?

The game features five main sections: Home, Training, Mission, Dashboard, and Results. Players learn about lunar survival challenges, complete mission-based scenarios, and make decisions to solve different problems. Their choices affect resource levels and mission progress, helping them understand the importance of resource management in future lunar exploration.

3. Benefits and Intended Impact

LUNAR MISSION provides an engaging way for students to learn about lunar environments, human survival beyond Earth, and the challenges astronauts may face. It encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and scientific curiosity.

Our intended impact is to make space science more accessible to young learners, promote STEM education, and inspire students to explore future opportunities in science and space exploration.

4. Tools and Technologies

We developed the project using:

  • Lovable: An AI-assisted website development platform used to create and improve the website.
  • JavaScript (JS): Used to implement interactive features and game logic.
  • TypeScript (TS): Used for application development and type safety.
  • JSON: Used for data representation and project configuration.

5. Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of LUNAR MISSION is its combination of space science education and interactive simulation. Instead of simply reading scientific information, players learn by taking on the responsibilities of a lunar base commander and making decisions that affect the survival and operation of their base.

This approach transforms scientific concepts into practical learning experiences and makes space exploration more engaging for students.

6. Factors Considered During Development

Our team considered several important factors:

  • Scientific accuracy: Using reliable scientific information and NASA references to support the educational content.
  • Educational value: Making scientific concepts understandable for high school students and beginners.
  • User experience: Creating a clear, accessible, and easy-to-navigate interface.
  • Functionality: Ensuring that the main pages, game interactions, and resource tracking work properly.
  • Accessibility: Developing a responsive website that can be accessed on different devices.
  • Realism: Distinguishing simplified game simulations from actual NASA measurements and real-world lunar conditions.
